goal: A research article on token-frugal agentic writing that passes all 8 hard gates at Q >= 70.

tasks.title: Outline the article structure
tasks.instructions: Produce a section outline with a word target per section and the one claim each section must establish.
acceptance: Every required section of the research rubric has a title and a word target
The outline names the gap the article answers in one sentence

tasks.title: Card sources for related work and method
tasks.instructions: Find primary sources for the related-work and methodology sections and record one locatable SourceCard per source. Do not write prose.
acceptance: Every card has a DOI or a URL and a snippet of at most 60 words
At least six sources cover both supportive and dissenting work

tasks.title: Draft introduction and related work
tasks.instructions: Draft both sections as patches against the empty sections. Cite only cards that exist; open an issue when a claim has no card.
acceptance: Each section is within 10 percent of its word target
Every in-text citation resolves to an existing SourceCard

tasks.title: Draft methodology and results
tasks.instructions: Draft both sections as patches, describing only the procedure and numbers present in the brief or the cards.
acceptance: The procedure is reproducible from the text alone
No number appears that is absent from the brief or a source card

tasks.title: Review the four drafted sections
tasks.instructions: Assess evidence, reasoning and clarity against each task's acceptance list. Set section status; do not rewrite prose.
acceptance: Every open high-severity issue names a section and a fix of at most 30 words
Reviewed sections move to reviewed status or keep a listed issue

tasks.title: Validate the article against the rubric
tasks.instructions: Measure the article, report all 8 hard gates and score every soft criterion. Flag any reference left unverified.
acceptance: All 8 hard gates are reported with evidence
Every soft criterion carries a score between 0 and 100
